recentItems.title: Comedian Jeff Hiller Makes His Case for Elsbeth | Hear Me Out | CBS
recentItems.description:
In Episode 1 of CBS’s new digital series HEAR ME OUT, Emmy-winning comedian Jeff Hiller (Somebody Somewhere) joins host Jay Jurden to prove why ELSBETH belongs on your watchlist!

HEAR ME OUT is a new CBS YouTube-first digital series where celebrity superfans convince host Jay Jurden to binge their favorite CBS shows.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #Elsbeth
Follow Elsbeth on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/elsbethcbs
Follow Elsbeth on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@elsbethcbs
Like Elsbeth on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/elsbethcbs
Watch more Elsbeth HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/elsbeth

Emmy Award winner Carrie Preston is Elsbeth Tascioni, the brilliant yet unconventional consent decree attorney working with the NYPD to track down New York’s most entitled murderers utilizing her unique, intuitive point of view. The critically acclaimed series enters its fourth season with fresh cases, family drama and new pressures on Elsbeth and the 11th Precinct, led by her boss, Captain C.W. Wagner (Wendell Pierce). ELSBETH is based on the character featured in THE GOOD WIFE and THE GOOD FIGHT.

Key Questions Answered
* What makes Elsbeth different from traditional crime dramas?
* Who are some of the biggest celebrity guest stars on Elsbeth?
* Which episode of Elsbeth did Jeff Hiller guest star in?
* What is it like working with Wendell Pierce on the set of Elsbeth?
* What is the upcoming Robert and Michelle King legal series Cupertino about? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 Welcome to Hear Me Out with Jay Jurden
00:52 Jeff Hiller Pitches Elsbeth
02:47 Meeting Elsbeth Tascioni
03:54 Jane Krakowski and Broadway Cameos
05:54 Dream Guest Stars and Murder Plots
07:05 Jeff Hiller’s Guest Appearance as Felix
09:31 Julia Fox on Black Veil
12:22 Heartwarming Family Moments and Wendell Pierce
14:09 Surprise Guest Brittany Inge Arrives
16:28 First Look at Cupertino
18:01 Tap Dancing Stories and Final Verdict

Play-by-Play Overview
* Host Jay Jurden introduces Hear Me Out, welcoming Emmy winner Jeff Hiller to pitch his favorite CBS television series. 
* Jeff pitches Elsbeth as a quirky, Murder, She Wrote-style comedy featuring high-profile guest killers and bold outfits. 
* Jay and Jeff watch Elsbeth’s introduction in New York City and discuss her signature "quirky aunt" energy and endless tote bags. 
* The duo breaks down Broadway legend Jane Krakowski’s rock-climbing murder episode and brainstorms dream guest killers like Raúl Esparza and Bernadette Peters. 
* Jeff reveals he guest-starred on Elsbeth as a killer wig maker named Felix, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and clips from his episode. 
* They watch a clip of Julia Fox playing a widowed reality dating show contestant on a show-within-a-show called Black Veil. 
* Jeff highlights the emotional core of the series by showing a heartfelt scene between Wendell Pierce’s Captain Wagner and his daughter. 
* Elsbeth star Brittany Inge makes a surprise appearance on the couch to discuss acting alongside Wendell Pierce and filming in New York City. 
* Brittany introduces a sneak peek of Cupertino, a new tech-focused legal drama from Elsbeth creators Robert and Michelle King starring Mike Colter and Ella Stiller. 
* Brittany manifests Audra McDonald as a future guest star, Jeff shares a hilarious Broadway tap-dancing audition fail, and Jay officially decides to binge Elsbeth.

recentItems.title: Carrie Preston's Balloon Pop Game Gets Personal | Elsbeth | CBS
recentItems.description:
Carrie Preston pops confetti balloons to answer fan trivia, revealing dream guest stars, favorite wardrobe coats, and behind-the-scenes secrets from Elsbeth.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #Elsbeth
Follow Elsbeth on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/elsbethcbs

Emmy Award winner Carrie Preston is Elsbeth Tascioni, the brilliant yet unconventional consent decree attorney working with the NYPD to track down New York’s most entitled murderers utilizing her unique, intuitive point of view. The critically acclaimed series enters its fourth season with fresh cases, family drama and new pressures on Elsbeth and the 11th Precinct, led by her boss, Captain C.W. Wagner (Wendell Pierce). ELSBETH is based on the character featured in THE GOOD WIFE and THE GOOD FIGHT.

Key Questions Answered
* Who is Carrie Preston’s ultimate dream guest star to appear on Elsbeth?
* What is Elsbeth Tascioni’s all-time favorite wardrobe item, and which coat does Carrie love most?
* How has leading a hit CBS network series transformed Carrie Preston’s life and career?
* Which guest star return was Carrie's favorite on-set moment from this season?
* What kind of mystery location does Carrie want Elsbeth to investigate next?
* What is Carrie Preston’s favorite attraction and park to explore in New York City?

Timestamps
0:00 Introduction and balloon pop rules
0:13 Dream guest star reveal
0:23 Elsbeth's closet and favorite coats
0:45 Leading a CBS series and career impact
1:08 Favorite season moment and guest appearance
1:21 Future mystery storylines and settings
1:36 Expectations for the upcoming season
1:50 Carrie's favorite New York City spot

Play-by-Play Overview
1. Carrie Preston introduces the pop quiz challenge where confetti colors dictate which question bowl she draws from. 
2. She bursts the first balloon and immediately names Meryl Streep as her number one dream guest star.
3. Popping another balloon, Carrie explains that Elsbeth’s wardrobe philosophy is wearing whatever comes out first, before highlighting her own favorite coat styled like a pack of Smarties.
4. She reflects on playing the titular lead on a CBS network series, expressing deep lifelong gratitude for the career-defining opportunity.
5. Carrie shares her standout season highlight: welcoming Tracey Ullman back to play an entirely distinct second role.
6. She pitches her dream case setting for future episodes, choosing a classic mystery set inside a library.
7. Looking ahead to next season, she praises the production team and proudly champions the cast and crew as the best in television.
8. Carrie concludes the game by naming The High Line as her favorite New York City park and landmark, praising its rotating art installations and stunning urban landscaping.
